class Order < ApplicationRecord
  after_commit :log_commit, on: :create
  after_rollback :log_rollback, on: :create

  private

  def log_commit
    Rails.logger.info "Order #{@id} was successfully committed."
  end

  def log_rollback
    Rails.logger.info "Order #{@id} was rolled back."
  end
end
